Say: It was told to me that a group of jinn listened and said: We heard an amazing Quran.
It shows the right way, so we believed in it. We will never put anyone beside our Lord.
And high is the greatness of our Lord. He never had a wife or a child.
But the foolish ones among us used to say wrong things about Allah.
We thought that people and jinn would never tell lies about Allah.
Some people used to ask for help from some jinn, but this only gave them more trouble.
They thought, like you thought, that Allah would never bring anyone back to life.
We tried to reach the sky and found it full of strong guards and fire.
We used to sit in places there to listen. But whoever listens now finds a fire waiting for him.
We do not know if bad is meant for the people on earth, or if their Lord wants good for them.
Some of us are good, and some of us are less than that. We are in different groups.
We know that we cannot beat Allah on earth, and we cannot run away from Him.
When we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord does not fear loss or harm.
Some of us obey Allah, and some of us go the wrong way. Those who obey are the ones who look for the right way.
But those who go the wrong way will be wood for Hell.
If they had stayed on the right way, We would have given them plenty of water to drink.
To test them with it. Whoever turns away from remembering his Lord, He will lead him to a punishment that keeps growing.
The mosques are for Allah. So do not call on anyone else together with Allah.
And when the servant of Allah stood up calling on Him, they almost crowded on him.
Say: I only call on my Lord, and I put no one beside Him.
Say: It is not in my power to harm you or to guide you.
Say: No one can protect me from Allah, and I will find no safe place except with Him.
I can only pass on the message from Allah. Whoever does not obey Allah and His Messenger will have the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever.
Until they see what they were promised, then they will know who has weaker helpers and fewer people.
Say: I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord will make it later.
He is the Knower of what is hidden. He does not show what is hidden to anyone.
Except a messenger He chooses. Then He sends guards in front of him and behind him.
So that He knows they delivered the messages of their Lord. He knows everything about them and counts everything.
